description: Fetch historical time series data for employment, inflation, wages, productivity, or housing. Returns dated data points with values. Provide a BLS series ID (e.g., "CES0000000001" for total nonfarm payroll employment, the headline Employment Situation jobs number; "LNS14000000" for the unemployment rate). "PAYEMS" is the FRED id for the same series, not a BLS id.

_apiKey.description: BLS registration key (optional, increases rate limits)

series_id.description: BLS series ID (e.g., "LNS14000000" for unemployment rate). For multiple series, comma-separate them (e.g., "LNS14000000,CES0000000001").

start_year.description: Start year (e.g., "2023"). Default: current year minus 2.

name: bls_get_series
